The function 'genericPrint' in 'printer-markdown.js' is responsible for the main printing logic for Markdown nodes, including code blocks. If it fails to correctly parse the language identifier when there are additional attributes, the downstream formatting (and syntax highlighting) will not occur. In 'embed.js', the 'embed' function handles embedding and formatting of code blocks, including determining the parser to use based on the language identifier. Both of these functions are directly involved in code block processing and need to be updated to correctly detect the language even when attributes are present after the language identifier.
